explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/703: is it true that for every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 with T(n,r) < (2−δ)^n for all εn < r < (1/2−ε)n? Proved by Frankl–Rödl. T n r is the largest family of subsets of Fin n with |A ∩ B| ≠ r for all A, B ∈ F, including A = B as in the page's wording. The statement quantifies exactly as on the page. Faithful.
